verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents a native Shares feature. Read access can be granted to specific users, roles, or accounts in the organization, and data can be shared publicly with any MotherDuck account in the same cloud region, including users outside the organization. Recipients attach a share URL (md:_share/...) rather than receiving an export, and an include pattern can limit which tables and views a Share exposes. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that shares are live and zero-copy, private targeted sharing with a specific external organization (cross-org is only via public shares in the same cloud region), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
